gaps.explanation: Statement (trimmed p5, GAAP modified accrual, Governmental Funds) total revenues 7,810,982. detail[] uses the Budgetary Comparison Schedules (pp13-16, budgetary basis 'Resources (inflows)') for four funds plus the nonmajor combining statement (p17). Per fund, statement column vs printed schedule total: General 5,336,131 vs 5,321,641 (p13) = +14,490; Street 1,171,674 vs 1,169,575 (p14) = +2,099; LB840 401,088 vs 915,469 (p15; includes budgetary 'Other income' 514,381 not in GAAP revenues) = -514,381; Debt Service 167,418 vs 178,860 (p16) = -11,442; Other Governmental Funds 734,671 = nonmajor 595,901 + 2,235 + 62,175 + 53,291 + 21,069 (p17) = 0. Sum 14,490 + 2,099 - 514,381 - 11,442 = -509,234 = gap. Budgetary-basis actuals vs GAAP; no missing or duplicate lines.

Statement (trimmed p5) total expenditures 8,864,325 vs schedules. Per fund: General 6,504,496 vs 6,436,121 (p13 total charges to appropriations) = +68,375; Street 1,264,196 vs 1,325,233 (p14) = -61,037; LB840 352,500 vs 992,500 (p15, single line General government-economic development) = -640,000; Debt Service 372,311 vs 374,220 (p16) = -1,909; Other Governmental Funds 370,822 = nonmajor 308,950 + 13,300 + 42,690 + 5,882 (p17) = 0. Sum 68,375 - 61,037 - 640,000 - 1,909 = -634,571 = gap. Budgetary-basis charges to appropriations vs GAAP expenditures; no missing or duplicate lines.
